{{Top|leg}}
'''''Imperial Center Today''''' was a Coruscanti publication issued since at least the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Declaration of a New Order|founding]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the periodical published a debate, titled "A LONG TIME AGO&hellip;: The Zhell and the Taungs Are Names to Conjure By, But the Truth About These Long-Lost Combatants Is Hard to Pin Down" regarding the verses of [[Dha Werda Verda|Dha Verda Werda]] and its connection to either the [[Zhell–Taung war|Zhell-Taung War]] or the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]], with the article being written by [[Eschul Shaywa]].
